name: autoheal_watchdog
description: Install and verify the Vrooli autoheal supervisor in the invoking user's native boot scheduler.

boot_policy.description: Dedicated hosts enable Linux user lingering for pre-login startup; shared hosts remain login-scoped.

storage.rationale: The safeguard owns only the invoking user's native scheduler entry; it never writes a root-owned autoheal service.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

linux.evidence: Manifest-declared applicability; no host-sampled qualification recorded.
